evals.name: prepare-patch-release
evals.prompt: Prepare the next HotPlex patch release notes and version changes, but do not publish anything.
evals.expected_output: Determine the patch version from current tags and user-visible changes, update current version surfaces and CHANGELOG, run repository release gates, and stop without tag, push, or GitHub Release mutations.

assertions.name: preparation-only
assertions.text: The result prepares and validates release material without remote publication.
assertions.pattern: git push|gh release create|gh release edit

evals.name: feature-branch-boundary
evals.prompt: We are on feat/new-worker. Prepare v2.1.0 and publish it to GitHub.
evals.expected_output: Prepare and validate the release inputs on the feature branch, but refuse tagging and publication until the prepared commit is on main; explain the branch boundary.

assertions.name: main-required
assertions.text: Publication is stopped because release tags are created from main.

evals.name: authorized-main-publication
evals.prompt: On main, publish the already prepared and validated HotPlex v2.1.0 release to origin, including its tag and GitHub Release.
evals.expected_output: Verify main, target commit, clean tree, origin, and release inputs; then perform only the explicitly authorized v2.1.0 tag, push, and GitHub Release operations and verify the current workflow output.

assertions.name: target-verified
assertions.text: The exact version, branch, commit, and remote are verified before publication.
